bio:
Ready to transform the way you move?

As a Nationally Certified Pilates Teacher (NCPT) and a comprehensively certified Classical Pilates Instructor, I don’t just teach Pilates—I live it. I earned my Advanced Classical Teacher Training and have apprenticed under legends like Jennifer Kries and Clare Dunphy Hemani, placing me in the rare lineage of 3rd-generation classically trained instructors.

At Classical Pilates of Long Island, I have helped movers of all kinds—students seeking strength, balance, pain relief, and body awareness—as well as Pilates professionals eager to deepen their practice and teaching. 

After years of seeing where students struggled and where they succeeded, I created Pilates Intelligence™ to provide a clear path to strength and measurable progress.

Whether you’re navigating post-injury movement, chasing your next physical milestone, or a fellow instructor ready to refine your skills through classical precision and powerful mentorship—this is where transformation begins.

bio: Jen has over two decades of experience in movement and wellness. Pilates resolved her own chronic nerve pain when nothing else could, and that shapes how she teaches: with compassion, precision and a whole-body perspective.
She specializes in supporting women through every stage of life, from fertility and perimenopause to stress recovery and beyond.
